// Generated by XNA Reborn. Offline stand-ins for XNA APIs that MonoGame does not provide.
// Fixed values: one local signed-in player "Player1" who is not on Xbox Live, the full (not trial) game,
// and a guide that is never visible. Message boxes finish at once and report "cancelled".
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Linq;
using XnaReborn.Compat;

namespace Microsoft.Xna.Framework.GamerServices
{
    /// <summary>The icon of a message box. Kept for source compatibility.</summary>
    public enum MessageBoxIcon
    {
        None,
        Error,
        Warning,
        Alert,
    }

    /// <summary>Stand-in for an XNA gamer.</summary>
    public abstract class Gamer
    {
        private static readonly SignedInGamerCollection _signedIn =
            new SignedInGamerCollection(new[] { new SignedInGamer(PlayerIndex.One, "Player1") });

        internal Gamer(string gamertag)
        {
            Gamertag = gamertag;
        }

        public string Gamertag { get; }

        public string DisplayName => Gamertag;

        public object? Tag { get; set; }

        /// <summary>Always one local player.</summary>
        public static SignedInGamerCollection SignedInGamers => _signedIn;
    }

    /// <summary>Stand-in for a signed-in player. Never signed in to Xbox Live.</summary>
    public sealed class SignedInGamer : Gamer
    {
        internal SignedInGamer(PlayerIndex playerIndex, string gamertag)
            : base(gamertag)
        {
            PlayerIndex = playerIndex;
        }

        /// <summary>Never raised: the local player is already signed in.</summary>
        public static event EventHandler<SignedInEventArgs>? SignedIn
        {
            add { }
            remove { }
        }

        /// <summary>Never raised.</summary>
        public static event EventHandler<SignedOutEventArgs>? SignedOut
        {
            add { }
            remove { }
        }

        public PlayerIndex PlayerIndex { get; }

        public bool IsGuest => false;

        public bool IsSignedInToLive => false;
    }

    /// <summary>The players that are signed in.</summary>
    public sealed class SignedInGamerCollection : ReadOnlyCollection<SignedInGamer>
    {
        internal SignedInGamerCollection(IList<SignedInGamer> gamers)
            : base(gamers)
        {
        }

        /// <summary>The player at a controller, or null.</summary>
        public SignedInGamer? this[PlayerIndex index] => this.FirstOrDefault(g => g.PlayerIndex == index);
    }

    public sealed class SignedInEventArgs : EventArgs
    {
        public SignedInEventArgs(SignedInGamer gamer)
        {
            Gamer = gamer;
        }

        public SignedInGamer Gamer { get; }
    }

    public sealed class SignedOutEventArgs : EventArgs
    {
        public SignedOutEventArgs(SignedInGamer gamer)
        {
            Gamer = gamer;
        }

        public SignedInGamer Gamer { get; }
    }

    /// <summary>Stand-in for the Xbox guide. Nothing is shown and nothing waits.</summary>
    public static class Guide
    {
        /// <summary>Set to true to test trial code. False unless set.</summary>
        public static bool SimulateTrialMode { get; set; }

        public static bool IsTrialMode => SimulateTrialMode;

        public static bool IsVisible => false;

        public static void ShowSignIn(int paneCount, bool onlineOnly)
        {
        }

        public static void ShowMarketplace(PlayerIndex player)
        {
        }

        public static IAsyncResult BeginShowMessageBox(
            PlayerIndex player,
            string title,
            string text,
            IEnumerable<string> buttons,
            int focusButton,
            MessageBoxIcon icon,
            AsyncCallback? callback,
            object? state) =>
            CompletedAsyncResult.Complete(callback, state, null);

        public static IAsyncResult BeginShowMessageBox(
            string title,
            string text,
            IEnumerable<string> buttons,
            int focusButton,
            MessageBoxIcon icon,
            AsyncCallback? callback,
            object? state) =>
            CompletedAsyncResult.Complete(callback, state, null);

        /// <summary>Always null, which XNA uses for a box that was cancelled.</summary>
        public static int? EndShowMessageBox(IAsyncResult result)
        {
            CompletedAsyncResult.ValueOf<object>(result);
            return null;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Stand-in for the component that pumped Xbox Live. Does nothing.</summary>
    public sealed class GamerServicesComponent : GameComponent
    {
        public GamerServicesComponent(Game game)
            : base(game)
        {
        }
    }

    /// <summary>Stand-in for the XNA 4.0 services dispatcher. Does nothing.</summary>
    public static class GamerServicesDispatcher
    {
        public static bool IsInitialized { get; private set; }

        public static void Initialize(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
        {
            IsInitialized = true;
        }

        public static void Update()
        {
        }
    }
}
